# Sabbir Ahmed Minhaz (SAM)

> Co-Founder, CTO & AI Engineer in Bangladesh. Builds AI workflow automations, voice agents, and intelligent systems.

## Who

Sabbir Ahmed Minhaz, known as SAM, is Co-Founder, CTO and AI Engineer at CodeMyPixel, a 10-person software and AI automation agency based in Bangladesh. His work focuses on AI systems that do real production work: agentic workflow automation, real-time voice agents, and document intelligence for legal and real estate businesses.

## What he does

- AI workflow automation: tool-using agents that handle email, ledgers, payments, quotations, and PDF workflows
- Voice AI: production voice agents with sub-second latency (streaming ASR/TTS, smart turn-taking, telephony integration)
- Legal AI: automatic contract signing and contract/legal document analysis
- LLM engineering: local LLM setup, fine-tuning, structured outputs, grounding

## Products

- Novilla: agentic workflow automation for appraisers (email automation, ledger/accounts automation, smart payment links, quotations, PDF handling)
- Vocale: voice agents, support automation, and follow-up systems
- Lex Claro: contract signing and legal document analysis

## Earlier work

- 3D deep learning research: brain lesion detection with YOLO and U-Net on 3D MRI scans (0.88 mAP, 0.71 Dice coefficient)
- TextGPT: end-to-end AI chat product built on the OpenAI API
- Top Floor Trends: SaaS content platform for a UK media agency with AI-assisted content tools
